Epidemiologist with an interdisciplinary background in psychology and public health. I specialise in linking complex data sources and applying quantitative methods to large-scale registry and real-world health data.

*A full CV (PDF) is available on request — [get in touch](mailto:n.hlubek@umcutrecht.nl).*
